info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Creditcard Applications Documents-v2-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Applications Document Listing API enables users to retrieve documents associated with credit card applications. This API serves as a critical resource for financial institutions and developers looking to access application documentation efficiently. Typical consumers include customer service representatives and application processors who require quick access to necessary documents for verification or audit purposes. By integrating this API, organizations can streamline their workflow and enhance operational transparency regarding credit card application management.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of documents associated with applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch all documents linked to applications in the system, enabling them to manage and review related documentation efficiently.
